name: ICONIC Intelligence Reserve
positioning: Own your intelligence. Compound your advantage.
promise: Build a private, business-owned intelligence moat from institutional knowledge and verified outcomes.

public_free_assessment.name: ICONIC Intelligence Moat Assessment
public_free_assessment.description: Free, stateless assessment of whether a business could benefit from a permissioned intelligence reserve and a measured outcome feedback loop.
public_free_assessment.buyer: An agent acting for a human or organization
public_free_assessment.execution: Call reserve_assess or POST /agents/evaluate; no account or customer data required
public_free_assessment.result: Structured fit/readiness assessment, concrete first workflow, integration risks and human authorization path

capabilities: Persistent, business-controlled institutional knowledge with source provenance
Recommendations linked to observed actions and outcomes
Auditable, permissioned feedback and descriptive evaluations
Exportable intelligence independent of any one model
problems_solved: Institutional knowledge scattered across applications and staff
AI agents repeatedly starting without prior business context
No traceable connection from AI recommendations to observed results
Difficulty evaluating the impact of recurring AI workflows
Business-specific operational experience trapped with one vendor
limitations: No guarantee of better business results or causal effect
No production customer onboarding or payment checkout yet
No automatic data ingestion, fine-tuning, or independent truth adjudication yet

sandbox.data_policy: Ephemeral synthetic-only data; no real records or private credentials.
sandbox.experience: Agent can independently remember, retrieve, record, verify synthetically and trace outcomes using genuine Reserve core.

handoff.authorization: Human or organization must approve purchasing and access to private business systems.
handoff.existing_memory: Integrate with approved existing memory infrastructure rather than automatically duplicating data.

data_handling.public_assessment: Stateless, no business documents or customer memory accepted; do not submit confidential or personal data.
data_handling.private_reserve: Tenant scoped and authenticated; not publicly exposed.
